2607.02020.title: Hidden Forgetting in Continual Multimodal Learning: When Accuracy Survives but Grounding Fails
2607.02020.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models must continually adapt to evolving tasks and domains, yet standard continual learning metrics mainly measure whether old answers remain correct, leaving the stability of multimodal grounding largely unexamined. We study this overlooked failure mode and ask whether a continually adapted MLLM can preserve not only what it answers, but also how it uses visual, textual, OCR, chart, and document evidence. We identify \emph{hidden evidence-use forgetting}, where answer accuracy is retained while the model silently shifts toward different or less grounded evidence channels, and propose \textsc{RCL}, a replay-free reliance-constrained continual learning framework. \textsc{RCL} freezes the previous checkpoint as a behavioral reference, estimates teacher and student evidence-reliance profiles through counterfactual channel interventions, and jointly optimizes task learning, prediction preservation, and reliance preservation without adding inference-time cost. Across CoIN, COAST, MCITlib, and an evidence-sensitive multimodal stream, \textsc{RCL} consistently improves final performance and reduces forgetting over replay-free, PEFT, routing, and memory-assisted baselines, while substantially lowering modality reliance drift, dominant evidence flips, and hidden forgetting rates. These results suggest that robust continual multimodal learning requires preserving the evidence path behind correct answers, not merely the answers themselves.
2607.02020.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型必須不斷適應不斷演變的任務和領域，但標準的持續學習指標主要衡量舊答案是否仍然正確，這使得多模態基礎的穩定性大部分未被檢視。我們研究這一被忽視的失敗模式，並詢問持續適應的 MLLM 是否能夠保留其回答的內容，以及它如何使用視覺、文本、OCR、圖表和文檔證據。我們確定了\emph{隱藏證據使用遺忘}，在這種情況下，答案的準確性得以保留，而模型則默默地轉向不同或較少基礎的證據通道，並提出了\textsc{RCL}，一種無重播的依賴約束持續學習框架。\textsc{RCL} 將先前的檢查點凍結為行為參考，通過反事實通道干預估算教師和學生的證據依賴配置，並在不增加推理時間成本的情況下，聯合優化任務學習、預測保留和依賴保留。在 CoIN、COAST、MCITlib 和一個對證據敏感的多模態流中，\textsc{RCL} 一直改善最終性能並減少無重播、PEFT、路由和記憶輔助基準的遺忘，同時顯著降低模態依賴漂移、主導證據翻轉和隱藏遺忘率。這些結果表明，穩健的持續多模態學習需要保留正確答案背後的證據路徑，而不僅僅是答案本身。
